---
applyTo: 'src/components/**/*.tsx'
---

# Component Guidelines

- Use named exports: `export function MyComponent()`
- Import UI primitives from `@/components/ui/`
- Use `cn()` from `@/lib/utils` for conditional classes
- Wrap animated sections with `<AnimateOnScroll>` from `@/components/shared/animate-on-scroll`
- Use `<Container>` for consistent max-width and padding
- Use `<SectionHeading>` for section titles with optional descriptions
- Do NOT manually edit files in `src/components/ui/` — these are generated by shadcn
- Base UI components do NOT support `asChild` — use `buttonVariants()` for styled links
- Only add `'use client'` directive when the component uses React hooks or browser APIs
